name: extEquivCohomologyClass_symm_add
statement: CohomologyClass R.cochainComplex ((singleFunctor C 0).obj Y) n) : R.extEquivCohomologyClass.symm (x + y) = R.extEquivCohomologyClass.symm x + R.extEquivCohomologyClass.symm y

name: extMk_comp_mk₀
statement: ℕ} (f : R.complex.X n ⟶ Y) (m : ℕ) (hm : n + 1 = m) (hf : R.complex.d m n ≫ f = 0) {Y' : C} (g : Y ⟶ Y') : (R.extMk f m hm hf).comp (Ext.mk₀ g) (add_zero _) = R.extMk (f ≫ g) m hm (by simp [reassoc_of% hf])

name: mk₀_comp_extMk
statement: ℕ} (f : R.complex.X n ⟶ Y) (m : ℕ) (hm : n + 1 = m) (hf : R.complex.d m n ≫ f = 0) {X' : C} {R' : ProjectiveResolution X'} {g : X' ⟶ X} (φ : Hom R' R g) : (Ext.mk₀ g).comp (R.extMk f m hm hf) (zero_add _) = R'.extMk (φ.hom.f n ≫ f) m hm (by simp [← φ.hom.comm_assoc, hf])
